author: Inside Edition
description: Chris Harrison is back on television hosting a new dating show called "The Vow." Harrison is best known for hosting "The Bachelor," but he stepped away from the show in 2021 after defending a social media post from a contestant who had once attended a "plantation-themes" sorority party. Now, Harrison is back with his new show on Fox Nation, and reportedly his old bosses at ABC are not happy with the news.
title: Chris Harrison Is Back With New Dating Show And 'The Bachelor' Bosses Aren't Happy

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump honored the fallen at Arlington National Cemetery on Veteran's Day. He was joined by First Lady Melania, who stood alongside Second Lady Usha Vance. Trump spoke about his triumphal arch, which he wants to erect on a traffic circle near the entrance to the cemetery. Construction was scheduled to begin this week, but now nine members of the Kennedy family are suing to put a stop to it.
title: Trump Squares Off Against The Kennedys Over Triumphal Arch

author: Inside Edition
description: A man accused of a fatal hit-and-run is the son of two major stars. His dad is Antonio Sabato Jr., who rose to fame as a model, and his mother is Oscar-nominated actress Virginia Madsen. 32-year-old Jack Sabato is accused of mowing down a pedestrian in Alaska, then fleeing the scene. Police say Sabato told them he thought he had hit an animal and did not stop because he does not have insurance. His father said in a statement that his family is still digesting the horrible news.
title: Son Of Hollywood Stars Accused Of Fatal Hit-And-Run In Alaska

author: Inside Edition
description: For the first time, we are hearing from the Black Ole Miss roommates who say they were targeted with racially offensive sounds and gestures by two white students outside their apartment. The shocking display, which was caught on their doorbell camera, has outraged the nation. The Black students say they were hurt and devastated by the acts, and are not ready to forgive the perpetrators. One of the white students has apologized for her behavior. The school said the white students' behavior was unacceptable and it was investigating the incident.
title: Black Ole Miss Students Taunted With Monkey Gestures Speak Out

author: Inside Edition
description: Australia is the world’s largest island, so naturally things need to be bigger Down Under. The rule even applies to their fly swatters. The Big Fly Swat is a new oversized attraction in Kingoonya, in South Australia’s Outback. The Big Fly Swat was made from recycled materials and solid steel. It’s almost 50 feet tall and just over 20 feet wide. The town, which has just 13 residents, is hoping it boosts tourism.
title: Giant Fly Swatter Unveiled In Australian Outback

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman was rushed away from her burning car as police officers came to her rescue. It happened in Fairfield, Ohio. Cops say the woman was trapped in the vehicle after getting into an accident. Upon learning the woman was stuck, responding officers and witnesses worked to free her as flames spread through the vehicle. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Rescuers Pull Woman From Burning Car Moments Before Vehicle Is Engulfed

author: Inside Edition
description: A baby was found “clinging to life” after being buried alive in a dog crate for 24 hours, South Carolina authorities say. The Lexington County Police say 11-month-old Koah Sharpe had been missing since Monday, when he was taken by his father, Michael Comer. Comer was arrested, and law enforcement said they are working with the solicitor’s office to determine what charges, if any, could be filed in the case. Comer remains in police custody.
title: Baby Found ‘Clinging To Life’ Inside Buried Dog Crate

author: Inside Edition
description: Police say they have arrested a man they believe is responsible for three rapes that occurred in New York’s Central Park. The NYPD released video of the suspect after the latest incident on October 24th. Investigators say he approached a woman in the park and pulled a knife before sexually assaulting her. He then allegedly fled on foot, while she was taken to a local hospital. Authorities have identified the suspect as Dereck Rivera-Deleon. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Central Park Rape Suspect Arrested In Miami Burger King

author: Inside Edition
description: New York teen Raymond Wright Jr. has been found guilty of second-degree murder in the killing of his 14-year-old girlfriend, Samantha Humphrey. Humphrey’s family used billboards to call attention to the case, much like in the movie “Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri.” Wright’s sentencing is scheduled for January of 2027; he faces a sentence of 15 years to life in prison. Samantha’s father spoke to Inside Edition Digital about the verdict.
title: Boyfriend Found Guilty Of Teen’s Murder In New York ‘Three Billboards’ Case

author: Inside Edition
description: A family says they confronted a worst case scenario while driving on a highway. Jack Spence was driving his grandmother Beth Wagner and his mom back to their Iowa home when they realized the police were in pursuit of another vehicle. As the chase got closer to them, they told KCCI they saw the fleeing car come straight for their vehicle. Jack says he was able to pull over to the side of the road. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: High-Speed Wrong-Lane Highway Chase Almost Hits Family
